name: Kaioken Plan
summary: Structural module that decomposes a repository into modules, generates knowledge cards for each module using an LLM, and persists plans/cards as YAML/JSON artifacts for later pipeline stages.
keyPoints: Module plan is a checkpoint artifact (module-plan.yaml) edited by humans and read back by later stages, not a derived output
Knowledge cards are generated per module via LLM, then verified against index/scan evidence to catch hallucinated declarations or files
Card generation supports incremental mode to only regenerate cards whose source files changed or are missing
Evidence gathering samples directives/files (max 12 symbols/dir, 120 dirs, 40 files/dir) to keep prompts bounded for large repos
Heuristic fallback (proposeHeuristicModules) exists for when no LLM client is provided, ensuring a plan can still be produced

entryPoints.name: proposeModulePlan
entryPoints.note: Main entry to decompose a repository scan/index into a module plan, optionally via LLM with heuristic fallback

entryPoints.name: generateCards
entryPoints.note: Main entry to generate knowledge cards for all modules in a plan, with verification and incremental support

entryPoints.name: writeModulePlan
entryPoints.note: Persists a module plan to module-plan.yaml in the kaioken directory

entryPoints.name: readModulePlan
entryPoints.note: Reads back a module plan from disk, returning null if absent

entryPoints.name: validatePlan
entryPoints.note: Validates a module plan against the scan, expanding directories and checking file coverage

entryPoints.name: gatherEvidence
entryPoints.note: Collects bounded repository evidence (files, symbols, entry points) to feed prompts and verification
